result.instructions: Tools for RemoteLock, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my locks are offline or have a low battery?"; "Create a guest code for Jane Smith that works at the Maple St unit from Friday 15:00 to Sunday 11:00."; "Who has access to the front door lock right now?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes RemoteLock data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run remotelock_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run remotelock_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run remotelock_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. remotelock_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: remotelock_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The RemoteLock account these credentials belong to: name, plan limits and settings. Use it to confirm which account is connected. GET /account.

tools.name: remotelock_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the account's locations (properties/sites) with address and time zone. Use the ids to filter devices. GET /locations.

sort.description: Sort order (default name ascending); a leading - is descending.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: remotelock_get_location
tools.title: Get location
tools.description: One location by id. GET /locations/{id}.

tools.name: remotelock_list_devices
tools.title: List devices (locks)
tools.description: List devices: locks, access-control doors, thermostats, etc., with name, model, battery/connectivity state, lock state and location. Filter by type (e.g. lock) or location. GET /devices.

location_id.description: Only devices of this location id.

sort.description: Sort order (default created_at ascending); a leading - is descending.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: remotelock_get_device
tools.title: Get device
tools.description: One device (lock) by id with its full state: connectivity, battery/power, lock state, auto-lock settings, model and location. GET /devices/{id}.

tools.name: remotelock_lock_device
tools.title: Lock a lock
tools.description: WRITE: sends the lock command to a lock (it locks the door). Locking an already locked door changes nothing. PUT /devices/{id}/lock.

device_id.description: RemoteLock device id (UUID) of the lock.

tools.name: remotelock_unlock_device
tools.title: Unlock a lock
tools.description: WRITE, SECURITY-SENSITIVE: sends the unlock command to a lock, which physically unlocks the door. Only call it when the user explicitly asked to unlock this specific door, and set confirm to true. PUT /devices/{id}/unlock.

device_id.description: RemoteLock device id (UUID) of the lock.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user explicitly asked to unlock this door.

tools.name: remotelock_list_access_persons
tools.title: List access users and guests
tools.description: List the people who can open doors: access users (permanent) and access guests (time-limited), with name, email, status, validity window and their PIN / card number. By default only current and upcoming people; pass status to include expired or deactivated. GET /access_persons.

type.description: Only permanent users or only guests.

status.description: Statuses to include (default current and upcoming).

sort.description: Sort order (default created_at ascending); a leading - is descending.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: remotelock_get_access_person
tools.title: Get access user or guest
tools.description: One access user or guest by id, with status, validity window and PIN / card number. GET /access_persons/{id}.

tools.name: remotelock_create_access_user
tools.title: Create a permanent access user
tools.description: WRITE: creates a permanent access user (an employee, resident or owner) with a PIN and/or card. It creates the person only; use remotelock_grant_access to give them doors. The reply includes the PIN. Check remotelock_list_access_persons first to avoid duplicates. POST /access_persons.

email.description: Email address (RemoteLock can email the access instructions).

pin.description: A PIN of 4-10 digits. Omit and set generate_pin to let RemoteLock pick one.

generate_pin.description: true: RemoteLock generates a random PIN (returned in the reply).

card_number.description: Prox card number, if the person uses a card.

tools.name: remotelock_create_access_guest
tools.title: Create a time-limited access guest
tools.description: WRITE: creates an access guest whose PIN/card only works between starts_at and ends_at (local time of the lock). It creates the person only; use remotelock_grant_access to give them doors. The reply includes the PIN. POST /access_persons.

email.description: Email address (RemoteLock can email the access instructions).

pin.description: A PIN of 4-10 digits. Omit and set generate_pin to let RemoteLock pick one.

generate_pin.description: true: RemoteLock generates a random PIN (returned in the reply).

card_number.description: Prox card number, if the person uses a card.

starts_at.description: Local date-time without a timezone, e.g. 2026-12-24T16:00 (read in the lock's time zone).

ends_at.description: Local date-time without a timezone, e.g. 2026-12-24T16:00 (read in the lock's time zone).

tools.name: remotelock_deactivate_access_person
tools.title: Deactivate an access user or guest
tools.description: WRITE: deactivates an access user or guest, so their PIN/card stops working on every door. The person stays in the account (status deactivated) and is not deleted. Only do it when the user asked. PUT /access_persons/{id}/deactivate.

annotations.title: Deactivate an access user or guest

tools.name: remotelock_list_person_accesses
tools.title: List a person's door access
tools.description: List the doors, door groups and locations one access user or guest can open, with sync state per device. GET /access_persons/{id}/accesses.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: remotelock_list_device_accesses
tools.title: List who can open a lock
tools.description: List the access users and guests who have access to one lock (and whether the PIN is synced to it). GET /devices/{id}/access_person_accesses.

device_id.description: RemoteLock device id (UUID) of the lock.

person_type.description: Only permanent users or only guests.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

annotations.title: List who can open a lock

tools.name: remotelock_grant_access
tools.title: Grant door access
tools.description: WRITE: gives an access user or guest access to a lock, a door group or a location, so their PIN/card opens it. RemoteLock then syncs the code to the lock(s). Optionally limit the hours with an access schedule (access_schedule_id, for recurring daily hours) or override a guest's start/end time of day on this door. POST /access_persons/{id}/accesses.

accessible_id.description: Id (UUID) of the lock, door group or location to grant.

accessible_type.description: What accessible_id is: lock, door_group, location, ...

access_schedule_id.description: Access schedule id, to limit the hours of a permanent user.

guest_start_time.description: Guests only: overrides the time of day the guest's access starts on this door, hh:mm. It is not a daily window: use access_schedule_id for recurring hours.

guest_end_time.description: Guests only: overrides the time of day the guest's access ends on this door, hh:mm. It is not a daily window: use access_schedule_id for recurring hours.

tools.name: remotelock_revoke_access
tools.title: Revoke door access
tools.description: WRITE: removes one access grant (an id from remotelock_list_person_accesses), so the person's PIN/card no longer opens that door, door group or location. The person itself stays. Only do it when the user asked. DELETE /access_persons/{id}/accesses/{access_id}.

access_id.description: The grant id (the id of an item from remotelock_list_person_accesses).

tools.name: remotelock_list_door_groups
tools.title: List door groups
tools.description: List door groups (named sets of locks you can grant access to in one step). GET /groups.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: remotelock_list_group_items
tools.title: List the locks in a door group
tools.description: List the items (locks) that belong to one door group. GET /groups/{id}/items.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

annotations.title: List the locks in a door group

tools.name: remotelock_list_notifications
tools.title: List notifications (activity)
tools.description: List notifications sent by notification subscriptions: each names the lock (publisher), the event type (unlocked, access_denied, jammed, power_level_low, ...) and an event_id. Only events that match a subscription appear. Get details with remotelock_get_event. GET /notifications.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: remotelock_get_event
tools.title: Get event
tools.description: One event by id (for example from a notification): type, time, source, status, the lock and the person involved, and the method used. The PIN or card used is not returned. GET /events/{id}.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with RemoteLock
prompts.description: What you can do with RemoteLock here, with example requests to try.
